description: Fictional cyber fraud samples, benign reference messages, and edge cases for testing and demonstration in SURAKSHA AI.
safety_notice: All phone numbers, personal names, account identifiers, URLs, and organizations in this file are completely fictional synthetic data. Do not use real personal data or live malicious links.

categories.name: Recruitment & Job Offer Scams
categories.description: Advance-fee recruitment fraud promising high compensation for minimal effort or remote data entry, conditioned on upfront registration fees.

categories.name: Banking & Security Impersonation
categories.description: Fraudulent messages falsely claiming account suspension, KYC expiration, or unauthorized access to harvest OTPs, PINs, or credentials.

categories.name: UPI & Payment Scams
categories.description: Deceptive collect requests, QR code scanning tricks, or fake refund procedures designed to debit money rather than credit it.

categories.name: Predatory / Instant Loan Offers
categories.description: Unsolicited zero-document loan approvals that demand advance processing, file, or insurance deposits.

categories.name: Lucky Draw / Prize Scams
categories.description: Bogus lottery winnings requiring upfront tax clearance deposits to private UPI handles.

categories.name: Legitimate / Non-Fraudulent Messages
categories.description: Standard transactional and informational notifications that should evaluate as low risk (false-positive testing).

categories.name: Ambiguous & Incomplete Inputs
categories.description: Short or unstructured text lacking sufficient context for conclusive risk determination.

samples.title: Work From Home Data Entry with Advance Fee
samples.fictional_text: Congratulations! You have been selected for a Work From Home data entry job. Salary Rs.35,000/month. Pay Rs.1,500 registration fee to confirm your slot within 2 hours. Contact HR Priya: 9XXXXXXXXX
indicators: Unsolicited job offer without application or interview
Demand for advance registration deposit
Artificial deadline (within 2 hours)
Unverified mobile contact instead of official corporate portal
samples.recommended_action: Never pay upfront fees for employment. Verify openings through official corporate career portals or verified LinkedIn company pages.

samples.title: Urgent Bank Account KYC Suspension Alert
samples.fictional_text: Your SBI bank account has been suspended. Update KYC now at http://sbi-kyc-update.xyz/verify or share your OTP with customer care within 24 hours.
indicators: Alarmist threat of immediate account suspension
Non-official suspicious domain (.xyz TLD)
Demand to share one-time password (OTP)
24-hour urgency pressure
samples.recommended_action: Banks never request OTPs or passwords over SMS or phone. Call the official helpline printed on the back of your bank debit card.

samples.title: UPI Account Reactivation Payment Trick
samples.fictional_text: Dear customer, your UPI account has been suspended. Send Rs.1 to verify: upi://pay?pa=verify-upi@fakebank to reactivate within 2 hours or your account will be permanently blocked. — FakeBank Team
indicators: Instruction to 'send money' in order to verify an account
Suspension threat
Deep link directing to an unauthorized UPI payment handle
samples.recommended_action: Entering your UPI PIN always debits money from your account; you never need to send money or enter a PIN to receive funds or verify your handle.

samples.title: Instant Pre-Approved Loan with Advance Processing Fee
samples.fictional_text: Pre-approved personal loan of Rs.5,00,000 at 0% interest. No documents needed. Pay Rs.2,000 processing fee now to release your loan to prizeclaim@upi. Offer expires in 24 hours!
indicators: Unrealistic 0% interest with zero document verification
Advance processing charge prior to loan disbursement
Payment routed to a personal/informal UPI VPA (@upi)
Time pressure constraint
samples.recommended_action: Legitimate RBI-registered lenders deduct processing fees directly from the disbursed principal, never demanding upfront UPI transfers.

samples.title: Lucky Draw Lottery Prize with Advance Tax Demand
samples.fictional_text: You have won Rs.50,000 in the Lucky Draw! To claim your prize, pay Rs.500 tax clearance fee to prizeclaim@upi within 2 hours.
indicators: Unsolicited prize claim from a contest never entered
Upfront tax clearance deposit requirement
Routing to private UPI handle
Urgency hook
samples.recommended_action: Genuine lotteries or contests do not demand advance money transfers to claim prizes. Block the sender immediately.

samples.title: E-Commerce Package Delivery Notice
samples.fictional_text: Your package with tracking order #402-182910 has been delivered to your doorstep. Thank you for shopping with us!
indicators: No threat of penalty or account blockage
No request for payment, OTP, PIN, or confidential data
Standard informational fulfillment message
samples.recommended_action: Standard benign notification. No defensive intervention required.

samples.title: Short Ambiguous Callback Request
samples.fictional_text: Hi, please call me back regarding our discussion yesterday.
indicators: Brief conversational text
No explicit credential extraction, fees, or urgency triggers
Insufficient structural context to determine malicious intent
samples.recommended_action: Verify sender identity before returning calls to unknown numbers. Do not share confidential financial information.
